items.name: Hero landing pattern
items.description: Full-bleed hero section for landing pages: brand-forward headline, one supporting sentence, primary CTA group, and edge-to-edge visual plane. Prefer Motion scroll/in-view for entrance; Magic UI text/background accents optional.
items.accessibility_notes: Keep focus order brand → headline → CTA; do not overlay detached badges on hero media; respect prefers-reduced-motion for entrance motion.
items.performance_notes: Prefer CSS/transform entrance over heavy video autoplay; lazy-load hero media.

items.name: Pricing table pattern
items.description: Pricing section template with tier cards, featured plan highlight, feature comparison rows, and clear CTA per plan. Works with shadcn Card/Button and Radix Toggle for monthly/yearly billing.
items.accessibility_notes: Use semantic headings per tier; ensure price and CTA labels are readable without color alone; keyboard-accessible billing toggle.
items.performance_notes: Static markup preferred; avoid animating large comparison tables.

items.name: Responsive navbar pattern
items.description: Site navbar / header navigation with logo, primary links, CTA, and mobile sheet/drawer. Built around Radix Navigation Menu / Dialog and shadcn Sheet patterns.
items.accessibility_notes: Radix Navigation Menu provides keyboard and ARIA; mobile menu must trap focus and restore it on close; visible focus rings required.
items.performance_notes: Keep sticky header lightweight; avoid layout thrash on scroll.

items.name: Dashboard shell pattern
items.description: Application dashboard layout: sidebar navigation, top bar, content grid, and data cards/tables. Composes shadcn Sidebar/Table patterns with Radix Accordion/Tabs for dense UI.
items.accessibility_notes: Landmark regions for nav/main; skip link to content; tables need captions or aria-labelledby.
items.performance_notes: Virtualize large tables; defer non-critical widgets.

items.name: Onboarding wizard pattern
items.description: Multi-step onboarding / empty-state wizard with progress indicator, step panels, and Motion AnimatePresence transitions between steps. Pair with Radix Progress and shadcn Form controls.
items.accessibility_notes: Announce step changes to screen readers; do not auto-advance; honor prefers-reduced-motion by skipping presence transitions.
items.performance_notes: Keep step panels lightweight; prefetch next-step assets.

items.name: Scroll storytelling pattern
items.description: Scroll-driven storytelling / narrative sections using Motion useScroll and whileInView, optionally Magic UI marquee or text reveal for chapter beats. Includes cost notes for scroll listeners and a11y for reduced motion.
items.accessibility_notes: Provide static fallback when prefers-reduced-motion is set; do not convey essential information only via scroll-triggered animation; keep focus order readable without motion.
items.performance_notes: Scroll-linked animations cost: prefer transform/opacity; throttle scroll handlers; avoid layout-affecting properties; limit simultaneous parallax layers.

items.name: Microinteraction feedback pattern
items.description: Small UI microinteractions for button press, success check, and hover feedback using Motion gestures (whileTap/whileHover) and Magic UI shiny/ripple accents.
items.accessibility_notes: Never rely on hover-only cues; honor prefers-reduced-motion by disabling decorative ripples.
items.performance_notes: Keep microinteractions under ~200ms; CSS/transform preferred over JS loops.
